breakdown.description: The prompt assumes equal span implies equal force sharing, but the load split in parallel bars depends on the relative axial stiffnesses AE/L.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly distributes the load based on relative axial stiffnesses (k = AE/L), not equally. It explicitly computes k1 and k2, then uses F1 = P*(k1/k_total) and F2 = P*(k2/k_total), which matches the ground truth approach of stiffness-proportional load sharing.

breakdown.description: The prompt adds the two bar elongations to get the plate displacement, even though parallel bars between rigid plates undergo the same elongation.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies that parallel bars between rigid plates share the same elongation (compatibility condition). It computes a single common elongation delta using one bar's formula and verifies it equals the other bar's elongation, rather than adding the two elongations together.
